description: Cast Iron Water Main Replacement is a dataset listed in City of Providence open data portal (performance.providenceri.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Providence. Cast Iron Water Mains replaced or relined per year. Coverage: Providence. The portal files it under the category Sustainability. Its tags are water, sustainability. The table has 2 columns. Attribution on the portal: Office of Sustainability. The portal shows 2018-03-28 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-performance-providenceri-gov-portal.
